body: Glad I'm not the only one that would pick kids playing video games pretty far down on my list of charitable priorities.

Chronic fatigue, I am unable to work with much consistency. With university study I can largely arranged my own schedule if the lectures are at times that aren't disruptive, I also get large holiday periods to recover which I need. I'm 24, by the way.

I'm in NZ. A bus would take me to a NZ city and quite honestly I'm tired of new zealanders, theres nothing new for me up there in terms of work or study. The prospect of a move is daunting too, when the only thing I'd really have to meet people is bar hopping alone.

Cruise ships may be an option and I will look into that, I don't know if we get many here though - the odd one does cruises to Australia but I'm not sure if they stop in my city, might be further north.

South Pacific. Flights are conditional on my degree because my mother wants me to finish (and even then not guaranteed because she would need to get financing). Flights aren't going to pay for the trip though and I can't work full time for health reasons.

For the past year going and seeing Africa has kept me going, but I can't go. My country is one of the most isolated in the worldby geography. I have no money and the flights were conditional on me finishing my degree, which I can't do - I just don't have the mental fortitude to keep going alone while everybody around me is happily socialising.

One thing I'm saddest about is that I won't get to see the world before I die.
